cases.name: U2 benign (spongiform nodule): reassure, no FNAC
U3 indeterminate (markedly hyperechoic, homogeneous, solid nodule with halo): US-guided FNAC
U4 suspicious (solid hypoechoic nodule): US-guided FNAC and neck assessment
U5 malignant (solid hypoechoic nodule with irregular outline and microcalcification): US-guided FNAC and neck assessment
U grade not stated: ask for it
U grade explicitly unknown: ask for it
